notes:
Describes actions, qualities, or people that display the bravery and nobility associated with a hero. Always carries a strongly positive, admiring connotation. Used in both serious and literary contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {英雄的|えいゆうてき}な⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧: heroic action
- {英雄的|えいゆうてき}な⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧: heroic sacrifice
- {英雄的|えいゆうてき}な⟦{活躍|かつやく}→活躍：02541_katsuyaku⟧: heroic achievements
- {英雄的|えいゆうてき}な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧: heroic figure
- {英雄的|えいゆうてき}な⟦{最期|さいご}→最期：30329_saigo⟧: heroic death

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{勇敢|ゆうかん}→勇敢：07637_yuukan⟧: brave, courageous — focuses on personal bravery without implying greatness or nobility
- ⟦{勇|いさ}ましい→勇ましい：11847_isamashii⟧: gallant, spirited — more literary; describes a dashing, spirited quality
- ⟦{大胆|だいたん}→大胆：07609_daitan⟧: bold, daring — emphasizes taking risks, not necessarily with noble purpose

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of ⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧ (hero) + ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). {英|えい} means outstanding and {雄|ゆう} means male/heroic.

definitions.explanation: displaying the courage, nobility, or greatness characteristic of a hero; brave and admirable in the face of adversity
